entities.name: Ignacio Martín-Baró
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignacio Martín-Baró was a scholar, social psychologist, philosopher and Jesuit priest who was born in Valladolid, Spain, and died in San Salvador, El Salvador. He was one of the victims of the 1989 murders of Jesuits in El Salvador.
